title: A Triangulation Test for Possible Thermodynamic Contributions to Gravitational Lensing in Galaxy Clusters
abstract: Introduces a triangulation methodology that compares lensing mass, hydrostatic mass, and ICM entropy gradients to test for small thermodynamic contributions to gravitational lensing in galaxy clusters. Applies the method to the Bullet Cluster and Abell 1835, finding no significant correlation at current sensitivity and outlining consistency requirements and detection thresholds for future stacked analyses.
